input_policy: reuse original frame IDs, PTS, HxW and tensor hashes
branch_policy: integer digits and decimal separator only; all other positions greedy; no fractional branch entropy
clipping: [0,actual metadata duration]; require start<end and EOS; do not sort reversed endpoints
levin: global priority log(answer token depth) minus native log path probability; compare every token, including greedy positions
allocation: native frontier mass weighted service credits; root first numeric fork defines disjoint fixed groups; best native prefix then greedy completion within group
novelty: native-mass-weighted mean of 1-max temporal IoU against completed intervals in other groups; unknown=0 bonus; native mass never divided by candidate count
checkpoint_policy: one cumulative search; actual decoder input positions including all replay; partial prefix materialization remains pending
entropy: exact clipped endpoint pair, conditional on observed valid mass; no entropy rebinning
scope: candidate proposal only; native-mass answer is a diagnostic proxy, not an independent verifier
prefill: shared once per query; attributed once per standalone method comparison; separately measured
